slice: Deferred AUDIT-002 provenance immutability and CLAUDE-M3A-002 engagement date contradictions
objective: Correct deferred findings AUDIT-002 and CLAUDE-M3A-002 on the integrated M3A baseline without expanding scope. AC-1/AUDIT-002: enforce immutable source provenance after creation by extending the IntegrityFinding/HardIntegrityError mechanism in candidate_memory/integrity.py so both MemorySourceDocument and MemoryClaimSupport reject instance-level and QuerySet-level bulk update/delete paths after creation, including Model.save()-based mutation, Model.delete(), QuerySet.update(), and QuerySet.delete(); registered source-document admin cannot delete; CASCADE deletion of claim-support evidence is replaced with a protective deletion policy so source deletion cannot cascade-destroy evidence; and a migration captures the policy. AC-2/CLAUDE-M3A-002: resolve the generic start/end date contradiction defect for the same engagement across sources, including a known Maruti start-date contradiction regression; this slice covers that date-contradiction defect only — non-date contradiction categories remain out of scope and deferred. Governed by FACT-002, FACT-003, requirements.md section 6.1, V2-D003, V2-D026, V2-D030, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4 (Durable State), the M3A acceptance statement in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md that unresolved source contradictions are preserved for operator review, docs/REQUIREMENT_TRACEABILITY.md line/entry 48 (Hard integrity vs soft review warnings | FACT-003, V2-D026), and the AUDIT-002 plus CLAUDE-M3A-002 entries in docs/DEFERRED_FINDINGS.md. On PASS, append RESOLVED disposition records for both findings in docs/DEFERRED_FINDINGS.md citing this run ID and candidate SHA; never rewrite or remove the original deferred entries. Prior run note: a prior live run of this same contract produced a complete, in-scope implementation at commit 403f3de03607010e11b94c081379128e547f25ed on branch agent/m3a-c1-430212be19ab/implementation (worktree .orchestration/worktrees/m3a-c1-430212be19ab/implementation); that run escalated only on the deterministic test-change evidence gate (candidate_memory/tests/test_migrations.py flagged for deleted/weakened lines despite a strengthening refactor), not on scope or correctness. The implementer may consult or reproduce that work (for example by cherry-picking commits from that branch) rather than re-deriving the implementation from scratch. Existing-test constraint: changes to EXISTING test files must be purely additive — no existing line in any test file may be modified or deleted; new assertions must be added as new lines or new test methods, never by editing an existing line. Specifically, the migration-0002 assertions in candidate_memory/tests/test_migrations.py must be added as new lines, leaving the existing migration-0001 assertions byte-identical to their current form. If an existing test genuinely must change because it asserts behavior this slice intentionally forbids (for example, a test that relies on being able to delete a source document, which AC-1 now prohibits), the implementer must NOT change it; instead it must report the exact conflict in the narrative's decisions_required field and stop with status BLOCKED, rather than attempting any edit to that existing test line.
